scope: Small Linux x64 engine-only worker transfer comparison; each memory initially has one 64 KiB page. This is not an upstream Lean-suite result.
finding: The downloaded 1.4.3-canary.1+a2b69f7b0 binary retains stable 1.4.2 shared memory64 worker-transfer failure. Fresh memory and transferred modules succeed; transferred memory reports a mismatched address type. Node and Deno controls pass.
classification: Observed Bun engine defect, not an established fundamental JavaScript restriction. Keep the stable runtime and lowered-memory workaround.
